known_defect.status: RETAINED AS A TEST FIXTURE - DO NOT USE AS CURRENT DATA
known_defect.cf_violation: GEO_U and GEO_V carry no units attribute; unit cm/sec appears only inside long_name. Fails STD-001, so S2 should reject this file.
known_defect.physical_defect: Geostrophic velocity is diagnosed as -(g/f) d(eta)/dy across latitudes -29.5 to 29.5, including the equator where the Coriolis parameter approaches zero. Measured over the full 2004-2019 record, ~15% of cells exceed 100 cm/s at every date. In the -1 to +1 degree band the median speed is 96 cm/s and the maximum is 2813 cm/s. At -30 to -20 degrees, where geostrophy is valid and the water is deep, 0.0% of cells exceed 100 cm/s.
known_defect.why_kept: Exercises the S2 CF-validation reject branch against real data rather than a synthetic fixture.
